instruction: Disable the tap-to-click feature on the touchpad to require physical clicks.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling tap-to-click feature by setting org.gnome.desktop.peripherals.touchpad tap-to-click to false. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.
